text: The **University of Maryland’s Global Forest Change (GFC) dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13)** detected the 2021 tree-cover loss in this asset. The observation tool confirms that the loss of **81.3 ha** was recorded in 2021, with **98% of the event area** corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference. The detection meets the engine’s corroboration rule, which requires agreement between the GFC dataset and the JRC reference. The MGAP forest map (2021) provided additional detail on forest type (planted pine species), but the initial detection came from Hansen GFC.
